## AccountUpdateInput.emptyJunkMessagesOnQuit property

Indicates whether the messages in the junk messages mailboxes will be deleted on quit. Cannot be reset: null is rejected.

**Signature:**

```typescript
emptyJunkMessagesOnQuit?: boolean;
```
